home.title: Write; let who, where and when link themselves.
home.lead: Kenet is a personal journal that links the short entries you write during the day to people, places and time. Tasks and goals live in the same place. Your data stays yours as plain Markdown files.
home.storeBadgeSoon: Coming soon to the App Store
home.promise1Body: Markdown is the source of truth. The vault is local; there is no account. Delete the app and the files remain.
home.promise2Body: The app writes to the file first, then updates its index. It never touches text it does not recognise. Deleting asks or can be undone.
home.promise3Body: The vault is the same as Obsidian's. No app specific syntax, no encryption of the vault.
home.principle1: Writing a line takes under 10 seconds.
home.principle2: You write, the app links: no folders, no tags.
home.principle3: When unsure, it asks. A wrong automatic link is worse than a question.
